div.head: CHn cor 14
div.ab: Si quis aliquid de meo uel de rebus alicuius post obitum regis Willelmi, fratris mei, cepit, totum cito reddatur absque emendatione.
Si quis aliquid de rebus meis vel de rebus alicuius post obitum Willelmi regis, fratris mei, cepit, totum cito sine emendatione reddatur.

If anyone, after the death of King William my brother, took possession of anything belonging to me or to any [other] person, it shall be restored immediately in full but without payment of compensation.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 282–283 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 522, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
